name: Habitas Alula
positioning: All-villa desert resort (officially Our Habitas AlUla) in the Ashar Valley, among AlUla's sandstone canyons and heritage sites
best_for: Travelers who want a villa base for Hegra and AlUla's heritage sites
Guests drawn to stargazing, desert hikes and outdoor art

facts.text: The resort is set amid AlUla's sandstone canyons and UNESCO World Heritage sites.
The resort sits in the Ashar Valley, a 20-minute drive from AlUla town.
The villas are sustainably designed to embrace the natural surroundings of the Ashar Valley.
The Arabian Villas are the resort's largest and most secluded accommodations, with views of the Ashar Valley.
Thuraya Wellness has a lounge with an alchemy bar, spa treatment rooms, a fitness center, an outdoor wellness agora and a yoga studio.
The infinity pool is set against the cliff.
Programming includes sunrise yoga on the Ashar Deck and live music featuring local talent.
The resort offers a Hegra day tour to Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its Nabataean tombs.
Stargazing at Gharameel combines the area's rock formations with dinner outdoors.
Several Desert X AlUla art installations are dotted across the valley.
Tama, the resort's restaurant, takes its name from the Aramaic for 'here and now'.
Tama's menu ingredients come from local farms in communities around AlUla.

highlights.text: Every villa has canyon views, a private outdoor lounge deck, a king-sized bed and both indoor and outdoor showers.
The Art Villas look out on one of the Desert X installations, such as Falling Stones Garden or Najma.
Guests can hike the resort's 8km Adventure Trail and stargaze with a local expert.
A complimentary daily program covers art and culture, wellness, adventure, learning, food and beverage, and music.

considerations.text: All villas are on the ground floor and are not accessible via lifts.
Rollaway beds are not available at this time.
Professional photography and drone use are prohibited on the property without prior approval.
